title: Yellowed Charred Middle Eastern Lamb Shawarma
description: A charred and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb, kaffir lime leaf, and steam, perfect for meal prep. This shojin-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and can be easily customized.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb for 5 minutes per side, or until charred and cooked through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the grilled lamb and serving it in the pita bread with your choice of toppings.
Steam the kaffir lime leaves for 1 minute to release their flavor and aroma.
Sprinkle the steamed kaffir lime leaves over the lamb and serve immediately.
